material_failure.cause: The runner represented non-converged BFGS calibration fits as NaN. Its predictive screen then used ordinary floating-point comparisons, for which comparisons against NaN are false, causing the negated calibration-regression condition to evaluate true. Missing calibration therefore passed instead of failing closed.
material_failure.affected_raw_claim: The raw report claimed predictive-screen passes for hits_1.5 and home_runs_0.5. Those claims are withdrawn and cannot be cited because pooled calibration was unavailable for at least one required arm in each market.
material_failure.proper_scores_and_intervals_status: Independently reproduced to near machine precision, but insufficient by themselves to satisfy the full predictive screen.

authorized_repair.calibration_solver: Solve the binomial calibration score equations with an analytic Jacobian using scipy.optimize.root(method='hybr').
authorized_repair.finite_gate: Require finite calibration intercept and slope for both empirical-Bayes and production arms before the calibration comparison can pass.
authorized_repair.mutation: A missing or non-finite required calibration estimate must force predictive_screen_passed=false.
